mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past month, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over the past month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that signal economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, sustained industrial production growth above 105.0 indicates strong supply momentum supporting earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion with INDPRO above 105.0, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
